title: Reflect starfield
description: A decorative field of tiny ink-coloured dots that slowly turns (one turn every 70s) while a second set twinkles in and out over 11s, fading out towards its edges. Drop it into any positioned box behind content.
notes: stars come from a fixed seed, so server and browser render the same field; change seed for a different sky
fills its nearest positioned parent; CSS only, still under reduced motion
name: reflect-starfield

props.name: count
props.description: how many stars (half steady, half twinkling)

props.name: size
props.description: side of the square field in px; it is centred on the parent and cropped by it

props.name: strength
props.description: star brightness, 0–100 (% of the ink colour)
